Query.Sql: select patient_identifier_value, clinical_date, clinical_datetime, clinical_code, trim(clinical_code) as concept_code from ##duckdb_source## where upper(trim(clinical_code_system)) = 'SNOMED CT' order by all

Explanation.Description: Patient NHS number, used to join existing OMOP Person records.
Clinical procedure date. Missing dates produce invalid procedure records.
Original procedure code, preserved as the source value.
Trimmed SNOMED CT code. Only Procedure-domain targets are retained.
